Initial release of affiliate-marketer-coach, an end-to-end coaching skill for affiliate marketers.

- Guides users through niche selection, keyword research, content strategy, and topical authority for various affiliate site models (content, review, deal, coupon, YouTube, newsletter, paid traffic).
- Supports advanced strategies: EEAT/Helpful Content Update defense, programmatic SEO, and monetization stacking beyond Amazon Associates.
- Advises on affiliate network/platform choices including Impact, ShareASale, CJ, PartnerStack, and more.
- Offers tactics for conversion optimization and site recovery after Google updates.
- Covers paid-traffic affiliates and site sales (e.g., via Empire Flippers or FE International).
- Refuses to support non-compliant or black-hat tactics (e.g., PBNs, AI-spam, deceptive landing pages).
